title: jimeng2api built-in skill configuration
description: Configuration items for the jimeng2api Jimeng/Dreamina image & video generation proxy. Effective config = defaults -> user file (<opc_home>/config/jimeng2api.yaml) -> CLI flags.

install_dir.description: Where the jimeng2api repo is cloned and run from. Empty string resolves to <opc_home>/integrations/jimeng2api at runtime.

repo_url.description: Source repository cloned on first start.

admin_key.description: JIMENG_ADMIN_KEY for the proxy. Empty = auto-generate a random key on first run.

api_key.description: Proxy-issued API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' for gen-image / gen-video calls. Required for generation.

auto_launch.description: Launch the proxy automatically when 'opc-jimeng2api start' runs.

open_page.description: Open the admin page in the browser after launch.
